method.source: VirusTotal public Detection and Details UI
method.completion_evidence: Result tables and Reanalyze button visible; no analyzing indicator observed.

distribution_verification.method: Downloaded published update archive; streamed named ZIP members through Python standard-library hashlib.sha256; did not execute archive contents.

historical_checks.summary: Historical record reports candidate-folder Defender custom scan (not whole-PC or boot-time offline), static privacy-pattern scan (not live traffic analysis), and archive inventory comparison. These checks were not rerun during this follow-up.

limitations: Results apply only to the named file hashes and stated report times; values may change.
The displayed denominator 60 is not the total 75 listed engine statuses.
Timeout, confirmed-timeout, type-unsupported and failure are not undetected results.
UI-observed result availability is not API-verified completion or successful completion by every engine.
These file reports do not constitute VirusTotal scanning of the entire distribution ZIP.
No detection is not a safety guarantee or proof of absence of privacy leaks.
Earlier r004 report results are not applied to these changed v1.0.1 files.

observed_between_utc.basis: Conversation/tool-time bounds around populated report DOM reads; not a timestamp embedded in the report DOM.
